reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Kubernetes Ingress API Group `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1`: In v3, the Kubernetes Ingress API Group `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1` (removed since Kubernetes v1.22)…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Ingress resources defined with the networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 API version will no longer be recognized or processed by Traefik v3.
consequence.remediation: Update all Ingress resource definitions to use the networking.k8s.io/v1 API version.

proposed.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.
